test_title: PYST 7: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

We should __desecrate __our national flag.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sanctify**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"desecrate"** means to treat (a sacred place or thing) with violent disrespect; violate. (अपवित्र करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Vandals desecrated the cemetery last night.
 
 
 
• **"Sanctify"** refers to making something holy or setting it apart as sacred. (पवित्र करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The priest sanctified the water before the baptism.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'desecrate'** is **'sanctify'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sanctify**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Integrate** (एकीकृत करना): To combine one thing with another so that they become a whole.

 
 
• **Example:** The new policy will integrate immigrants into the workforce more effectively.
 
 
 
• **Damage** (क्षति): Physical harm caused to something in such a way as to impair its value, usefulness, or normal function.
 
 
• **Example: **The storm caused significant damage to the buildings.
 
 
 
• **Violate** (उल्लंघन करना): To break or fail to comply with (a rule or formal agreement).
 
 
• **Example:** The company violated environmental regulations.
